name: Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas
description: In the southern Indian state of Karnataka, three 12th- and 13th-century Hindu temples at Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura show off the Hoysala dynasty's genius for stonework. Every surface is crowded with finely cut gods, dancers, animals and tiered friezes, almost like jewellery in stone. Visitors can walk the raised platforms around the shrines and study the carvings up close.
